title: Why structure and surface are always assessed together
summary: Treating one without the other rarely gives a complete picture.
body:
A face that looks tired might be a surface concern, a structural one, or both, and treating only one can leave the underlying cause unaddressed.

This is why every consultation at Dr Tranter Aesthetics considers both dimensions before any plan is proposed.

In our experience, the concerns patients arrive describing are often a downstream effect of something else entirely, which is exactly the kind of judgement a structured assessment is designed to catch.
